before_metrics.comment: exp-20260528-027 measured residual-eligible vs non-residual-eligible inside PEAD only on the primary_expectation_positive tier; this experiment broadens to three positive revision tiers and drops the residual filter.

change_summary: Tests the simpler PEAD hypothesis (without residual filter) across three independent positive expectation revision tiers on the exp-20260527-908 enriched watchlist: primary_expectation_positive (47 rows), wide_watchlist_positive (61 rows), scout_prev_positive (25 rows). Per tier, compares PEAD-window-in vs PEAD-window-out and vs baseline-not-in-tier at 5d (primary) and 10d (secondary) horizons. Mirrors exp-20260527-005 published gate_thresholds. Result: all three tiers show non-positive 5d PEAD-in vs PEAD-out lift; the cleanest comparison (wide_watchlist_positive, 25 closed 5d, size + concentration both pass) returns -0.40 pp 5d lift. The 10d horizon shows directional inconsistency across tiers and the pead_out comparison sample sizes are too small (1-3 closed observations) to be trusted.
decision_rule: Gate 4: if at least one tier shows 5d pead_in vs pead_out avg_return lift >= 0.01 with bucket-size floor and concentration limits passed, accept. Else if every tier's lift is <= 0, reject. Otherwise observed_only.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Positive expectation revision rows inside the T+2..T+15 PEAD window outperform the same rows outside the window, even without requiring residual leadership.
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260528-027 rejected residual filter inside PEAD; this experiment tests the simpler hypothesis. exp-20260527-005/006/007 closed observed_only_data_gap before exp-20260527-908 unblocked last_earnings_date.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: PEAD window flag inside each positive revision tier (no residual filter).
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: 5d pead_in vs pead_out avg-return lift >= 0.01 pp in at least one tier, with size + concentration limits passed.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Single deterministic script reading the exp-20260527-908 enriched artifact; 8 unit tests cover tier partition, gate accept/reject/observed_only logic, and per-tier diagnostic structure.

hypothesis: Even without requiring residual leadership, positive expectation revision within the PEAD window may produce a forward return lift over (a) the same revision tier outside the PEAD window and (b) the non-primary baseline. Tests three independent revision tier definitions present on the enriched watchlist (primary_expectation_positive 47 rows, wide_watchlist_positive 61 rows, scout_prev_positive 25 rows) so the rejection or acceptance does not rest on a single tier specification.
next_evidence_needed: Wait for the watchlist to span more than one earnings season before retrying; the 10d directional inconsistency across tiers (primary +1.12 pp, wide +0.35 pp, scout -0.48 pp) is the same single-window instability AGENTS.md Section 12 warns about. Independent of PEAD: eps_estimate_delta_30d remains 0 pct coverage; filling it unblocks the magnitude-of-revision alpha branch. The doc's Hypothesis 3 (sector/theme residual) remains untested because ret20_excess_sector and ret20_excess_theme are only partially covered; a sector/theme residual join into the watchlist is the next high-leverage measurement_repair.
rejection_reason: All three tier definitions show non-positive 5d PEAD-in vs PEAD-out lift (-0.40 to -0.94 pp). The cleanest comparison (wide_watchlist_positive, 25 closed 5d, both bucket-size floor and concentration limits passed) returns -0.40 pp lift. PEAD window does not improve 5d returns in this measurement window across any tier specification.
